20261121-physics-m2-1.steps.0.explain: A cikin $Q = cm\Delta T$, canjin zafin $\Delta T = \frac{Q}{cm}$. Ruwa abu ne mai zafin ƙayyadadde mai girma sosai, don haka zafin man girki mai ƙaramin zafin ƙayyadadde yana ƙaruwa da sauri sosai.

20261121-physics-m2-2.material: Menene dalilin kimiyya da ya sa ake bar wani tazara (rata) tsakanin haɗin layukan dogo yayin gina layin dogo?
20261121-physics-m2-2.thinking.0: Menene dalilin kimiyya da ya sa
20261121-physics-m2-2.s.s1.prompt: Menene dalilin kimiyya da ya sa ake bar wani tazara (rata) tsakanin haɗin layukan dogo yayin gina layin dogo?
20261121-physics-m2-2.s.s1.explain: Karafa suna ƙaruwa a tsawo ta faɗaɗar zafi idan zafi ya ƙaru. Idan ba a bar rata a haɗin ba, layin dogo da ya faɗaɗa a lokacin rani zai tura juna, wanda zai iya haddasa hatsarin fita daga layi.
20261121-physics-m2-2.s.s1.hint.0: Mafi yawan abubuwa masu ƙarfi suna ƙaruwa a girma da tsawo idan zafi ya ƙaru.
20261121-physics-m2-2.s.s1.hint.1: Wuri ne na ajiya don shirin faɗaɗar zafi.
20261121-physics-m2-2.s.s1.o.o0: Don hana layin dogo ya lanƙwasa saboda faɗaɗar ƙarfe ta zafi idan yanayin zafi ya ƙaru a lokacin rani
20261121-physics-m2-2.s.s1.o.o1: Don ƙara hayaniya idan jirgin ƙasa ya wuce
20261121-physics-m2-2.s.s1.o.o2: Don taimakawa layin dogo ya miƙe a lokacin sanyi

20261122-physics-m2-1.title: An haɗa juriyoyi guda biyu na
20261122-physics-m2-1.topic: An haɗa juriyoyi guda biyu na
20261122-physics-m2-1.goal: Apply principles of An haɗa juriyoyi guda biyu na to solve the reasoning problem.
20261122-physics-m2-1.material: [Nazarin da'ira mai zurfi] An haɗa juriyoyi guda biyu na 6 Ω da 3 Ω a layi ɗaya, sannan aka haɗa su da tushen wuta na 12 V. Menene jimillar wutar lantarki da ke gudana a wannan da'ira gaba ɗaya?
20261122-physics-m2-1.thinking.0: An haɗa juriyoyi guda biyu na
20261122-physics-m2-1.s.s1.prompt: [Nazarin da'ira mai zurfi] An haɗa juriyoyi guda biyu na 6 Ω da 3 Ω a layi ɗaya, sannan aka haɗa su da tushen wuta na 12 V. Menene jimillar wutar lantarki da ke gudana a wannan da'ira gaba ɗaya?
20261122-physics-m2-1.s.s1.explain: Juriya mai haɗawa ta haɗin layi ɗaya shine $\frac{1}{R_p} = \frac{1}{6} + \frac{1}{3} = \frac{1}{2} \implies R_p = 2\,\Omega$. Jimillar wutar lantarki shine $I = \frac{12\text{ V}}{2\,\Omega} = 6\text{ A}$.
20261122-physics-m2-1.s.s1.hint.0: Juriya mai haɗawa ta haɗin layi ɗaya: 1/R = 1/6 + 1/3 = 3/6 = 1/2, don haka R = 2 Ω.
20261122-physics-m2-1.s.s1.hint.1: Lissafa jimillar wutar lantarki I = V / R = 12 / 2.

20261122-physics-m2-2.title: Tulun ajiye abin sha mai ɗumi
20261122-physics-m2-2.topic: Tulun ajiye abin sha mai ɗumi
20261122-physics-m2-2.goal: Apply principles of Tulun ajiye abin sha mai ɗumi to solve the reasoning problem.
20261122-physics-m2-2.material: Tulun ajiye abin sha mai ɗumi da ke riƙe ɗumi na dogon lokaci yana da 'vacuum' (wuri maras iska) tsakanin bangonsa biyu, kuma bangonsa na ciki an shafe shi da 'azurfa'. Wanne zaɓi ne ya haɗa kowanne da hanyar yaduwar zafi da yake toshewa daidai?
20261122-physics-m2-2.thinking.0: Tulun ajiye abin sha mai ɗumi
20261122-physics-m2-2.s.s1.prompt: Tulun ajiye abin sha mai ɗumi da ke riƙe ɗumi na dogon lokaci yana da 'vacuum' (wuri maras iska) tsakanin bangonsa biyu, kuma bangonsa na ciki an shafe shi da 'azurfa'. Wanne zaɓi ne ya haɗa kowanne da hanyar yaduwar zafi da yake toshewa daidai?
20261122-physics-m2-2.s.s1.explain: Layin vacuum ba shi da wani matsakaici, don haka yana toshe yaduwar zafi ta taɓawa da ta juyawa gaba ɗaya, yayin da bangon da aka shafa da azurfa mai sheƙi yake mayar da hasken zafi na infrared zuwa ciki, yana hana asarar zafi.
20261122-physics-m2-2.s.s1.hint.0: Vacuum ba shi da abu a cikinsa, don haka yana hana yaduwar zafi ta taɓawa da ta juyawa, waɗanda suke buƙatar abu.
20261122-physics-m2-2.s.s1.hint.1: Shafen azurfa yana mayar da hasken zafi, wanda raƙuman lantarki-maganaɗisu ne (infrared).
20261122-physics-m2-2.s.s1.o.o0: Bangon vacuum biyu: yana toshe yaduwa ta taɓawa (conduction) da ta juyawa (convection) / cikin da aka shafa da azurfa: yana toshe asarar zafi ta hasken zafi (radiation)
20261122-physics-m2-2.s.s1.o.o1: Bangon vacuum biyu: yana toshe hasken zafi / cikin da aka shafa da azurfa: yana toshe yaduwa ta taɓawa
20261122-physics-m2-2.s.s1.o.o2: Dukansu suna toshe juyawar zafi (convection) kawai
20261122-physics-m2-2.s.s1.o.o3: Dukansu suna toshe faɗaɗar zafi kawai
